task: verify R14L-6 (hindsight guard for LESSONS), round 14, 2026-09-27
reason: CORE HOLDS, predictions need rework. The core (commit LESSONS s3 item 11 before the first private score, then only append a dated 'post-private note') is finals-neutral, uses 0 GPU and 0 slots, and is not a submission mechanism, so R8 does not apply and R1-R10 are not touched. Its value is real but small: process calibration only, no score. Three defects: (1) P2 (C2 = #37-#38 > 0, P 0.55-0.60) is ALREADY pre-registered and pushed (CONTEXT l.2288-2300, 26 Sep 16:04Z; LESSONS_draft l.70), so it adds nothing. (2) P1 ('L1, L2, L4 all display 0 on private' means 'the rules cost ~0') contradicts the registered READ RULE (CONTEXT l.2716-2718: '0 is uninformative; no ratio is estimated'). Private rank uses the unrounded score (LESSONS s3.6), so a displayed 0 inside a ~330-team tie block can still cost dozens of places. The 0.45 prior is near the comonotone bound: the independent product is 0.65*0.50*0.80 = 0.26, the upper bound is 0.50. (3) P3 (R14L-7 f_B > f_A) is the rank-vs-0.953-block reading that the 16:04Z registration rules out (rivals' private = max of their own 2 files; the block is not all x138 copies). It also fails to discriminate: under pure shrinkage, f ~ m^2/(m^2+s^2), where m is the public margin and s ~0.002 is the per-team embryo-shift noise. B's margin is +0.007..+0.013 and A's is +0.002..+0.004, so f_B > f_A is expected with NO route effect, and the 'own-model' label for B is unverified. The gate as written is also weak: a local commit date can be set by hand, while the GitHub push time (origin = github.com/vitalikney) is the external stamp.
fix: Make one text-only commit as the user (no trailer) and PUSH it to origin before 29 Sep 23:00Z. Record the pushed hash in CONTEXT. Contents: (a) LESSONS s3 item 11 (R14L-3 text) plus the clause 'do not rewrite after the private LB; append a dated post-private note only'. (b) Do not re-register P2. Point to C2 in the 16:04Z/v2 registration. (c) Replace P1 with a statement that follows the read rules: 'P1: at least one of L1, L2, L4 is non-zero on private, prior ~0.55-0.70 (1 - P(all zero), where P(all zero) is 0.30-0.45). A non-zero L > 0 counts as a cost of the ladder delay or of the finals rule. All zero is uninformative, NOT evidence of zero cost.' (d) Drop P3, or recast it as descriptive and confounded, with a shrinkage null that is also pre-registered: compute each group's expected f0 = m^2/(m^2+s^2), with s taken from the private spread of the exact-0.953 group. Read only f_g - f0_g, keep the 'rivals = max of 2 files' confound label, and never use it to rank s4. Gate: the push time on GitHub is earlier than the first private-LB publication, checked on 30 Sep.
realistic_gain: 0 score, 0 GPU, 0 slots, about 15 min of editing. The only gain is that the post-deadline lessons (s3/s4) are not refitted to one private draw. Most of the prediction content (C1-C5, L1-L5 priors) is already frozen and pushed, so the part that is new is the s3 item 11 text and the no-rewrite clause.
